# Global Soccer Manager attribution

Jornada 90 uses an original offline commentary implementation inspired by the documented architecture of **Global Soccer Manager**.

Source project: ecrou-exact/Global-Soccer-Manager
License: Apache License 2.0
Source: https://github.com/ecrou-exact/Global-Soccer-Manager

Only the architectural idea of separating match events from commentary generation was used. No source code, templates, phrase banks, assets, or player/team data from Global Soccer Manager are copied into Jornada 90.

The Jornada 90 commentary implementation is original and deterministic, runs offline, and consumes the game's own match events.
